title: A Structural Framework for Succession: Continuation, Recognition, and Realization
abstract: arXiv:2611.20422v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Succession asks whether an entity encountered later is the same entity that entered an arrangement earlier. For an artificial system that is fine-tuned, distilled, or copied, it has to be answered. We look for a mathematical structure weak enough to cover any such case and strong enough to support general theorems, so that results follow from the structure's conditions rather than from a particular pipeline or criterion. Succession is modeled on state/modification graphs with relational lifts that compose along paths. Within this framework we separate four questions that are often conflated: which continuations a representation admits, which descendants are compatible with a modification, which are recognized as continuing the identity, and which are realized. translated_title: 继承的结构化框架：延续、识别与实现
translated_abstract: 继承所问的是：后来遇到的实体是否就是早先进入某个安排的那一个实体。对于经过微调、蒸馏或复制的人工系统，这一问题必须得到回答。我们寻找一种数学结构，它足够弱以涵盖任何此类情形，又足够强以支持一般性定理，从而使结论由结构自身的条件推出，而非依赖于某个特定的流程或判据。继承被建模在状态/修改图上，并配有可沿路径复合的关系提升。在该框架内，我们将四个常被混淆的问题区分开来：一个表示容许哪些延续、哪些后代与某次修改相容、哪些后代被识别为延续同一身份、以及哪些被实现。该框架使人们能够系统地处理对称性、计算复杂性、可恢复性以及对部分实现的鲁棒性等问题，并且我们确立了……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于状态/修改图与关系提升的“继承”数学框架，将延续、修改相容、身份识别与实现这四个常被混淆的问题分离开来，从而能够系统地分析微调、蒸馏或复制后的人工系统中关于身份继承的对称性、计算复杂性、可恢复性与鲁棒性等一般性定理。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces a structural mathematical framework for succession—based on state/modification graphs with path-composable relational lifts—that disentangles continuation, modification compatibility, recognition, and realization, enabling general theorems about symmetry, complexity, recoverability, and robustness for identity succession in fine-tuned, distilled, or copied artificial systems.
